# CANDIDATE: RIBBON_SPREAD_MIN_20_CENTS

**Filed:** 2026-09-07  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** parameter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Requiring a minimum ribbon spread of 20 cents (instead of the default 30 cents) will increase trade frequency by capturing setups with tighter ribbons while avoiding choppy markets. We expect this to improve edge capture on J bearish days by allowing more entries on strong moves like 4/29 and 5/04, though it risks admitting false signals in low-volatility regimes.

## Mechanism

Entry trigger: BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup (per playbook) with additional condition that ribbon spread (Fast EMA to Slow EMA) ≥ 20 cents. Exit logic unchanged: chart stop (primary invalidation: SPY closes 3-min candle above rejected level + $0.50 buffer), chandelier profit-lock (arms at +5%, trails 0.15 off HWM), premium stop (catastrophe cap: −50% for Safe), and time stop (15:50 ET). Position sizing follows risk-rules.md (3-contract minimum for $1K–$2K accounts, scaling upward).

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** Strategy requires $25K+ account for full qty (15 contracts Safe per playbook). $1K paper realizes ~14% headline P&L. Numbers are notional BS-synthetic P&L; real OPRA fills may differ ±10-30% due to liquidity and slippage (L23).
2. **Sample bias:** Test period 2025-Q1–2026-Q2 (6 quarters). Sample includes regime shifts but risks overfit from single-parameter sweep (ribbon spread min=20c) without OOS validation. Positive quarters: 2/6 indicates inconsistency.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (no walk-forward test performed)
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (no real OPRA fill validation performed)
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Loses on 4/29 (−$23.95) and 5/01 (−$21.56) — fails to capture two largest J winner days.
   - Takes and profits on call options on 5/07 (J loser day for puts) — indicates lack of directional filter or regime misclassification.
   - Negative wide P&L (−$1464.23) over test period — loses money outside J days.
   - Low win rate (18.7%) and large average loss relative to average win.
6. **Concentration:** Edge_capture ($759.21) driven by 5/04 (+$804.72) offsetting losses on 4/29 and 5/01 (−$45.51 net). Without 5/04, edge_capture = −$45.51 (below 771 floor). Top 1 J day (5/04) contributes 106% of net edge_capture (due to offsetting losses).

## Pre-merge gate

Gym validators (100% pass), walk-forward OOS (ratio ≥ 0.70), real-fills on top-3 J days (diff < ±20% vs BS-sim), edge_capture ≥ 771, no regression on anchor days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04 winners captured; 5/05, 5/06, 5/07 losers skipped or lose less).

## Confidence

2 / 10 -- Edge_capture (759.21) below OP-16 floor (771), no OOS/real-fills validation, and strategy loses on two of three J winner days. Mechanism shows promise on 5/04 but fails to capture 4/29/5/01 reversals.
